rules.statement: In a publishing workflow, tag an image `latest` only when its version is stable; never tag a prerelease `latest`.
rules.why: A consumer following `latest` should only receive stable releases, while prereleases are selected through a semver range that includes them.
rules.check: Look for a workflow step that pushes a `latest` tag without a condition that the version has no prerelease suffix.

rules.statement: When a workflow publishes an artifact (container image, Helm chart, OCI document), sign its digest keylessly with `cosign sign` and attest it with `actions/attest-build-provenance`.
rules.why: Every published artifact is signed and attested so a consumer can verify where it came from and who built it.
rules.check: Look for a new or changed push of an image, chart or OCI artifact with no matching `cosign sign` and `attest-build-provenance` step for that digest.

rules.statement: Give a job that verifies published artifacts read-only permissions, and have it pull them anonymously without logging in to any registry.
rules.why: Pulling anonymously makes the run fail when a package is private or unreachable, which an authenticated pull would hide.
rules.check: Look for a verify job that has write permissions or runs a registry login step (docker/login-action, `helm registry login`, `oras login`) before it pulls the artifacts.

rules.statement: When a build argument stamps a version into an image build, reject any value with a character outside `[0-9A-Za-z.-]`, and fail the build unless the stamped version actually took effect.
rules.why: Rejecting unsafe characters keeps an injected value out of the build, and failing when the stamp didn't take effect means an image always reports the version its tag names.
rules.check: Look for a Dockerfile or build script that writes a version build argument into version files without validating its characters or confirming the result afterwards.

rules.statement: Generate a published OpenAPI document at build time, for example with the `GenerateOpenApiDocuments` target of `Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server`, instead of fetching it from a running host.
rules.why: A running host needs a database and a deployment. The document describes the product rather than a deployment, so it is published whatever a deployment chooses to serve.
rules.check: Look for build or workflow steps that start a host and download its OpenAPI endpoint to produce the published document, or that make publishing the document depend on runtime API-reference switches.

rules.statement: Package a Helm chart so that its `version`, its `appVersion` and the image tags it deploys are all the same artifact version.
rules.why: The chart pins its image tags to its `appVersion`, so a consumer that follows the chart's version alone also gets the matching images.
rules.check: Look for a `helm package` call that does not pass the same value to `--version` and `--app-version`, or for chart templates that set image tags apart from `.Chart.AppVersion`.
